feature_modules.label: Generic Feature Module
context_alignment: Use Build.complete/Start-tab/mapping as write authority.
Reuse local resources before creating new code/docs/tests.
Documentation/testing/reuse plans stay feature-only unless behavior-preserving refactor is selected.
steps: Resolve selected chain entry.
Identify local resources and dependencies.
Patch smallest validated slice or produce plan/manual gap.
acceptance_criteria: Changed-files-only patch or explicit plan-only output.
Validation or manual gap.
Rollback and export manifest delta.
match_rules: generic fallback for all feature entries

feature_modules.label: Last Git Commit Feature Module
context_alignment: Use Patch-tab Git repository detection as read-only source.
Scan when Last-Git-Commit plan is selected before Prompt Builder compilation.
Expose Reference D in Prompt Builder, USER_PROMPT and manifests when enabled.
steps: Resolve selected Last-Git-Commit plan.
Run read-only git status/last-commit scan once per signature.
Embed structured reference and Known Gap state.
acceptance_criteria: Prompt Builder shows the reference.
No Git writes, diffs, remote URLs or secrets are exported.
Manifest has last_git_commit_reference enabled/available/reason fields.

feature_modules.label: System Plan Expansion Module
context_alignment: Large plans are plan-first and decomposed into slices.
Catalog growth must not create generated scale variants.
steps: Add plan-first entries.
Declare acceptance, validation, rollback and non-goals.
acceptance_criteria: More slice types are available.
Big system plans do not become Big-Bang patches.

feature_modules.label: Project Packaging Windows Module
context_alignment: Existing-project evidence is required before patching.
Reuse local build/components/resources before adding new tooling.
Keep output rollback-ready and changed-files-only.
steps: Resolve selected feature plan and target path.
Check existing manifests, components and commands.
Patch the smallest safe slice or return plan-only Known Gap.
acceptance_criteria: Feature target is bound to verified project evidence.
Validation or manual test is explicit.
No broad project migration is hidden inside the slice.

feature_modules.label: Boilerplate Dependency CRUD Feature Module
context_alignment: Treat CRUD as the only user-selectable task from the former runtime/UI boilerplate group.
CRUD edits are bounded dependency-abstraction rows for the active target, not PromptEngineering or UI runtime work.
PromptEngineering context wraps the resulting TASK phases through the Human API mantle.
steps: Resolve the active target and selected CRUD row intent.
Create, update, delete or review only the requested dependency-abstraction rows.
Record validation, rollback and manifest delta.
acceptance_criteria: Only CRUD dependency-abstraction rows are changed.
No hidden PromptEngineering/UI runtime boilerplate becomes a task.
TASKS.TXT declares the CRUD work as an active checkbox-backed phase when selected.

refactor_modules.label: Generic Behavior-Preserving Refactor Module
context_alignment: Refactor preserves observable behavior.
Reuse local resources when it reduces duplication without changing behavior.
Testability seams are allowed only as small internal structure changes.
steps: State preserved behavior before patch.
Identify reusable local resources or test seams.
Patch smallest reversible structure change.
Validate behavior or document manual gap.
acceptance_criteria: No feature/fix/docs work hidden as refactor.
Behavior-preservation evidence or manual gap.
Rollback note and changed-files-only manifest delta.
match_rules: generic fallback for all refactor entries

refactor_modules.label: Last Git Commit Hardening Module
context_alignment: Behavior-preserving hardening of Git reference flow.
Reuse Patch-tab Git routine and same manifest payload.
steps: Check scan cache/signature.
Harden missing repo and timeout states.
Keep Prompt Builder and compact handoff files synchronized.
acceptance_criteria: No duplicate Git utility.
Plan selection scans before Prompt Builder compile.
Known Gaps are explicit.

refactor_modules.label: Slice Catalog Consolidation Module
context_alignment: Built-in plans, chain boilerplates, specializations and modules share IDs.
Unknown JSON fields are preserved.
steps: Align IDs.
Remove/avoid duplicated pseudo-plan semantics.
acceptance_criteria: One entry per change type.
Prompt Builder and export use the selected ID.

refactor_modules.label: Prompt Pipeline Boundary Hardening Module
context_alignment: USER_PROMPT, Prompt Builder preview, Create Preview and manifests must expose the same command and validation boundaries.
CMD.json is an export artifact, not a refactor plan.
TASKS.TXT remains a sidecar hook.
steps: Check command definitions and human prompt lines for equivalence.
Mirror commands into CMD.json.
Verify guardrails: no access, safety, scope or validation expansion.
acceptance_criteria: All shortcut commands are machine-readable and human-readable.
Shortcut hooks are not user-selectable catalog entries.
STATUS cannot invent unavailable session history.
STATUS portable output uses CMD_STATUS_PORTABLE_SESSION.html with cmd-status-* naming.
AI-CALLBACK/progress output uses the CMD Progress Canvas Style reference with cmd-progress-* naming.

refactor_modules.label: Search & Destroy Manual Savepoint Module
context_alignment: Search broadly, patch narrowly.
Stop at a logical manual-test/save point.
Preserve public behavior and rollback capability.
steps: Scan syntax/reference/schema/lint/performance/security risks.
Prioritize evidenced defects and remove false positives.
Patch safe findings until the next manual-test/save point.
acceptance_criteria: Findings are traceable and prioritized.
Behavior-preserving fixes stay small.
Manual save point, validation and rollback are documented.

refactor_modules.label: Boilerplate Dependency CRUD Refactor Module
context_alignment: Treat CRUD as a behavior-preserving dependency-abstraction cleanup task.
Do not convert UI/runtime PromptEngineering components into refactor tasks.
Keep Human API engineering context as wrapper-only guidance.
steps: Resolve existing CRUD rows and target boundaries.
Normalize, rename, remove or consolidate only explicit CRUD rows.
Document compatibility, validation and rollback.
acceptance_criteria: CRUD rows remain target-scoped and manifest-traceable.
No broad schema/catalog refactor is hidden inside the CRUD task.
PromptEngineering wrapper remains a mantle, not a phase.

prompt_builder_export_hooks_rule.tasks_txt: Automatic Prompt Builder sidecar hook only; never a target feature module.
prompt_builder_export_hooks_rule.shortcut_commands: Automatic USER_PROMPT export hook mirrored to CMD.json; never a target feature/refactor module.
prompt_builder_export_hooks_rule.tasks_sidecar: TASKS.TXT is a sidecar hook, not a module.
prompt_builder_export_hooks_rule.feature_refactor_boundary: create_new_abstraction entries are not Feature/Refactor modules; they are declared in create_abstraction_pipeline_extensions and chain boilerplates with mode new_project_abstraction.
